recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the seed resolution in the remaining active source location while leaving existing example-strength AuditEvent, Provenance, Contract, and ConsentDirective bindings unchanged.
issue_request: FHIR-24676 was Published/Persuasive with Modification. It originally asked FHIR security to create a PurposeOfUse value set assembling HL7 v3 PurposeOfUse and ISO 14265 PurposeOfUse codes, but the final resolution instead changed the binding to example so ISO codes can be used without a conflict.
initial_application: No source commit or current source comment explicitly mentioned FHIR-24676. Related R5 security terminology work had already left AuditEvent, Provenance, Contract, and ConsentDirective PurposeOfUse-related bindings at example strength, but git history showed Consent.provision.purpose remained extensible from the R4B draft through current HEAD.
additional_context: FHIR-27547 recorded MnM guidance about overlapping code systems in value sets, while FHIR-27548 left ISO vocabulary acquisition to HTA/TSMG rather than FHIR-core. Security WG minutes on 2021-11-22 describe the ISO PurposeOfUse problem and indicate Consent would change to example binding absent more concrete guidance; 2022-02-14 minutes also flagged FHIR-24676 as needing re-resolution around binding strength. FHIR-32515 separately lowered AuditEvent PurposeOfUse/authorization bindings to example.
reconciliation: Changed source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml so Consent.provision.purpose now has an example binding to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v3-PurposeOfUse. Consent is an active approved resource in source/fhir.ini, and the hunk removes the extensible-binding obligation that still conflicted with the seed resolution.
source_changes: source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml: changed Consent.provision.purpose binding strength from extensible to example.

related_jiras.note: MnM guidance issue about overlapping HL7/ISO PurposeOfUse-like value sets; already represented on the combined branch as an external-repo audit.
ISO 14265 vocabulary access request linked from this seed; resolved no-change with HTA/TSMG direction rather than a core source edit.
Separate Published issue that lowered AuditEvent PurposeOfUse/authorization bindings to example and explains the same extensible-binding problem for security PurposeOfUse codes.
